topic: sub:12|Trigonometry|Area of a triangle, A = ½ab sin C

figures.cap: triangle XYZ with XY = 10 m, XZ = 9 m

solutions.latex:
Using the area formula $A = \dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$:
$$\begin{aligned} 43 &= \dfrac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 9 \times \sin C \\ \sin C &= \dfrac{2 \times 43}{90} \\ C &= \sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{43 \times 2}{10 \times 9}\right) \\ &\approx 73^\circ \end{aligned}$$
criteria: Substitutes correctly into the area formula, or equivalent merit

figures.cap: triangle with sides 30 cm, 28 cm, x cm and included angle 44 degrees

parts.latex:
The area of the triangle shown is $250\ \text{cm}^2$.

NOT TO SCALE

\exfigure{2839_q1a_1}

What is the value of $x$, correct to the nearest whole number?

solutions.latex:
Using the area formula for a triangle, $A=\dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$:
$$\begin{aligned}250 &= \dfrac{1}{2}\times 30\times x\times \sin 44^\circ \\ x &= \dfrac{250}{15\sin 44^\circ} \\ &= 23.99\ldots\end{aligned}$$
To the nearest whole number $x=24$, which is option D.

figures.cap: radial survey from P to A 315, B 082, C 210

parts.latex: Show that angle $APB$ is equal to $127^\circ$ .
Hence, find the area of triangle $APB$ to the nearest $\text{m}^2$.

solutions.latex:
The angle is made up of the angle $82^\circ$ and the angle between $315^\circ$ and north.
$$\begin{aligned} \angle APB &= 82 + (360 - 315) \\ &= 82 + 45 \\ &= 127^\circ \end{aligned}$$

meta.format_note: Rubric written by us (source had none).

solutions.latex:
Using the area formula $A = \dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$:
$$\begin{aligned} A &= \dfrac{1}{2} \times 85 \times 122 \times \sin 127^\circ \\ &= 4140.92512\ldots \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ \text{area} \approx 4141 \text{ m}^2$$

figures.cap: triangle ABC with AB = 8 cm, BC = 12 cm, angle B = 32 degrees

solutions.latex:
Using the area formula for a triangle with two sides and the included angle:
$$\begin{aligned} A &= \dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C \\ &= \dfrac{1}{2}\times 8\times 12\times\sin 32^\circ \\ &\approx 25.4 \text{ cm}^2 \end{aligned}$$
Hence the area is $25.4 \text{ cm}^2$, which is option A.
